```python
from watcher_runtime import harness
from watcher_runtime.adapters import parcel_dhl

TRACKING_NUMBER = "00340434161094042557"
DEADLINE_ISO = "2026-10-03T16:00:00Z"

try:
    info = parcel_dhl.fetch(TRACKING_NUMBER)
except Exception:
    harness.fail("Could not reach DHL tracking service.")
else:
    now = harness.now()
    deadline_dt = harness.parse_time(DEADLINE_ISO)
    delivered = bool(info.get("delivered"))
    # If deadline has passed, settle the worry
    if now >= deadline_dt:
        fear_came_true = not delivered
        harness.emit(
            "resolved",
            "Parcel deadline passed." if fear_came_true else "Parcel delivered on time.",
            "dhl",
            {"delivered": delivered, "status": info.get("status")},
            next_check_s=86400,
            fear_came_true=fear_came_true,
        )
    else:
        # Before deadline: check estimated delivery
        est_str = info.get("estimated_delivery")
        if delivered:
            # Should not happen before deadline, but treat as resolved
            harness.emit(
                "resolved",
                "Parcel already delivered.",
                "dhl",
                {"delivered": True, "status": info.get("status")},
                next_check_s=86400,
                fear_came_true=False,
            )
        elif est_str:
            try:
                est_dt = harness.parse_time(est_str)
                if est_dt <= deadline_dt:
                    harness.emit(
                        "ok",
                        "Parcel expected to arrive before the deadline.",
                        "dhl",
                        {"estimated_delivery": est_str, "status": info.get("status")},
                        next_check_s=3600,
                    )
                else:
                    harness.emit(
                        "act_now",
                        "Parcel estimated to arrive after the deadline.",
                        "dhl",
                        {"estimated_delivery": est_str, "status": info.get("status")},
                        next_check_s=3600,
                    )
            except Exception:
                # Unable to parse estimated delivery
                harness.emit(
                    "act_now",
                    "Unable to determine delivery estimate.",
                    "dhl",
                    {"status": info.get("status")},
                    next_check_s=3600,
                )
        else:
            # No estimate and not delivered yet
            harness.emit(
                "act_now",
                "No delivery estimate available; parcel not yet delivered.",
                "dhl",
                {"status": info.get("status")},
                next_check_s=3600,
            )
```
